methodology: Sources used, in order of reliance: Ballotpedia race pages (Governor, U.S. Senate, NH-02, Executive Council, State Senate, NH House elections and Hillsborough 3); Citizens Count ward pages for Nashua Wards 1 to 9 (candidate lists and profile URLs) and Citizens Count candidate profiles (survey answers, Granite State Taxpayers survey answers, Nashua Ink Link questionnaire excerpts, and voting-record labels); NH Secretary of State 2024 state representative district list (ward to district mapping: Ward 1 = Hillsborough 5, Ward 2 = 4, Ward 3 = 6, Ward 4 = 3, Ward 5 = 9, Ward 6 = 8, Ward 7 = 7, Ward 8 = 11, Ward 9 = 10; no floterial district includes a Nashua ward); NH RSA 662:4 (County Commissioner District 2 = Nashua, Hudson, Litchfield, Pelham); The Ballot Brief, GoodParty.org and BallotReady for county offices; goodlander.house.gov, chrispappas.org and cindewarmington.com for social accounts; The Dartmouth, WCAX, Vermont Public, NHPR, Valley News, Patch and NH Journal for background. Incomplete: (1) The NH SoS 2026 general election candidate list PDF was found but blocked by the proxy, so the SoS list was not read directly; the Ballotpedia and Citizens Count lists agree with each other for every state and federal race. (2) County office candidate lists rest on The Ballot Brief (AI-assisted) plus GoodParty.org and BallotReady; Sheriff Brian Newcomb's party line(s) are not confirmed. (3) Ballotpedia's NH House elections page lists John Menyhard as not on the ballot for Hillsborough 3 while Ballotpedia's Hillsborough 3 page, Citizens Count and Nashua Ink Link list him as the Republican candidate; he is included. (4) Bluesky profile pages (bsky.app) could not be fetched; handles given are as published on the candidates' own sites. YouTube channel ids were confirmed from the channel pages for Pappas, Warmington, Goodlander (official House channel) and Avard only. (5) Campaign websites for Ayotte, Pappas (home page), Sununu, Goodlander, Williams, Mahrou, Wheeler and Levesque could not be fetched, so positions for those candidates come from Citizens Count, Ballotpedia and news coverage. (6) Laura Telerski and several House incumbents did not answer the 2026 Citizens Count survey; their stances are Citizens Count labels derived from votes and are marked as such. (7) Backgrounds for most State House candidates are not published on the sources read. (8) The 'what' sentence for each office is a general description written for this file, not a quoted source. A statewide constitutional amendment to eliminate the office of Register of Probate is also on the ballot (see county-register-of-probate.related_ballot_measure).
